text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: euc2-azd ingress cluster — sudden 5xx spike and connection resets to downstream services. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ingress-5xx. Pager severity: P1. thread_ts=4332107777
Ria Torres: I'm seeing traffic skew to euc2-azd ALB/NLB path. Frontend 5xx rate jumped ~12x at 13:02 UTC. Customers in EU reporting errors.
Sam Li: ack. I'm oncall. grabbing metrics and logs now. Can someone confirm if ALB healthchecks started failing or if Envoy backends are RST-ing?
observability-bot: Alert digest: euc2-azd -> ingress-envoy-pool: 5xx spike (p50 p95 p99 increased), envoy.conn_reset ~420/s, ALB_TargetHealth unhealthy_hosts +18 in last 2m.
Ria Torres: Logs from ALB show 502/504 ratios up. Envoy stats: 
```
cluster.ingress-backend.upstream_rq_5xx: 118
cluster.ingress-backend.upstream_cx_reset: 412
server.slot: connection_errors: 14
```
Also seeing repeated TCP FIN/RST from targets in azd-subnet-3.
Sam Li: probable causes: target instance NIC flapping, kernel conntrack exhaustion, or upstream NLB keepalive/backlog issues. First step: check instance-level metrics and conntrack on a few failing targets. Ria can you run the quick probe?
Ria Torres: running ssh to one unhealthy target (i-0a1b2c3d). output:
```
# sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_count
125678
# sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max
131072
# ss -s | grep max
TCP: 10572 (estab 8922, closed 421)
```
Conntrack is near max on that host. Kernel dmesg shows: 
```
nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet.
```
That would explain RSTs.
Jin Park: good find. Is this isolated to azd hosts or cluster-wide?
Ria Torres: sampling other hosts in azd-subnet-1/2 show similar high conntrack (~120k). euc1/euc3 are fine.
Sam Li: OK mitigation plan: short-term increase conntrack max via sysctl on azd autoscaling group, drain targets that are flapping, and shift traffic away from azd via DNS weighted routing to reduce load. I'll coordinate with infra automation to push sysctl change and adjust Route53 weights. Jin take on-call for follow-up once we stabilize. Maria please prepare customer comms noting partial regional impact.
Maria Gomez: on it. Drafting message to customers and CSE. ETA 8m.
Ria Torres: sysctl change applied to azd ASG via SSM document: 
```
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
sudo sh -c 'echo 262144 > /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max'
```
Pushing to remaining hosts now.
observability-bot: Config change detected for euc2-azd hosts: nf_conntrack_max updated -> 262144. New metric: conntrack_count dropping ~30% after 90s.
Sam Li: good. While we let that settle, I'm executing a quick Route53 shift: decrease weight for euc2-azd ingress pool from 0.5 -> 0.1 for 10 minutes to relieve pressure. Command: (internal cli) 
```
redwood-route set-weight --zone ingress.global --record ingress.redwood.ai --region euc2-azd --weight 10
```
Applying now.
Ria Torres: drainage started on the most saturated targets. ALB target healthcounts improving. Envoy conn_reset trending down. p95 latency normalizing.
observability-bot: Post-mitigation metrics (2m after changes): 5xx down 78%, envoy.conn_reset down 86%, ALB unhealthy hosts reduced to +2.
Jin Park: taking over on-call. I'll keep watch and run sweeps for root cause (why conntrack exploded). Suspect a client-side SYN flood or higher NATed connection churn from a backend batch job. Will check flow logs and Egress NAT devices.
Sam Li: handing off to Jin for full RCA. I'm leaving the incident channel to coordinate with infra for a more durable fix (conntrack tuning automation + alert thresholds). Maria, update customers with "regional degraded" template and note mitigation steps + ETA for next update in 30m.
Maria Gomez: published customer notice to status page and emailed top customers in the affected region. Copy: 
"We detected elevated 5xx errors impacting a subset of traffic in the euc2-azd region. We've applied infrastructure mitigations, shifted traffic away from the affected AZ, and error rates have returned to normal for most customers. We're continuing an investigation and will post a postmortem within 48 hours." :white_check_mark:
Ria Torres: additional note: found a misconfigured batch job in azd that opened many short-lived connections to ingresses (internal ETL retries). I've disabled the job pending fix. That reduced churn by ~40%.
Jin Park: noted. Next actions: 1) full postmortem, include timeline and mitigations; 2) add conntrack threshold alert before table gets >90% of max; 3) add an automated safety that reroutes traffic when unhealthy host delta >10 in 1m; 4) revisit client retry logic to exponential backoff.
Sam Li: thanks team. Closing P1 to P0 in 20m if metrics remain stable. I'll archive logs and create postmortem ticket: PM-INC-4332107777.
Ria Torres: thanks. will attach kernel logs and SSM run outputs to the ticket.
observability-bot: Incident closed (automated): 5xx spike resolved, no active mitigations. Metrics stable for 15m.
Jin Park: follow-up note: we've scheduled a changelist to permanently bump conntrack on euc2-azd host images and added a runbook step to check for batch-job connection patterns. Postmortem scheduled for 48h.
Maria Gomez: posted update to customers that we've resolved. Marking channel for postmortem discussion. :memo:
